description:
Using the Liverpool Cancer iChart app, perform a safety check for a patient taking Domperidone who needs to start cancer treatment. Check the drug interaction status for Domperidone against THREE specific cancer drugs: 1) Pazopanib, 2) Panobinostat, and 3) Vandetanib.

For each combination, note the traffic light color (Red, Amber/Orange, Yellow, or Green).

After checking all three, create a text file at '/sdcard/domperidone_report.txt'.
In this file, list the interaction color for each cancer drug and write a brief recommendation stating which of the three drugs (if any) appears safest to combine with Domperidone.
